description: We are a group of enthusiastic students and beginner developers who are passionate about space, technology, web development, and creative storytelling. We want to use NASA’s open data to build an engaging and visually interesting project that makes space exploration easier and more exciting for everyone.
summary: Rovelore Chronicles is an interactive storytelling web application that brings NASA’s abandoned Moon and Mars equipment back to life. Through voice-acted story conversations, we transform these forgotten machines into engaging experiences, allowing young explorers to discover their missions, contributions, and scientific importance. Interactive 3D hardware models further help users understand the technologies, physical structures, and engineering behind these historic explorers. By combining storytelling, scientific research, and interactive visualization, our project addresses NASA’s “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” challenge in an educational and engaging way. Ultimately, our project aims to preserve the legacy of these remarkable missions, inspire curiosity about space exploration, and ensure that their contributions are remembered by future generations—and that is exactly what Rovelore Chronicles strives to achieve.
details:
Rovelore Chronicles is an interactive web application designed to help users explore and learn about NASA's abandoned space equipment on the Moon and Mars. Users can select either the Moon or Mars map, where interactive markers guide them to different pieces of equipment. By selecting these markers, learners can discover each equipment's history and mission through voice-acted character conversations. Additionally, the Stories section provides concise summaries of each equipment, while the Explore section showcases authentic NASA images, videos, and 3D models for a deeper learning experience.

The application was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. ChatGPT and Gemini supported research and information analysis, while Claude assisted with coding and debugging. We also used VS code for file arrangements,Google AI Studio for AI-assisted development, GitHub for version control, and Vercel for deployment. NASA Official Archives,the Planetary Data System (PDS) & other datasets served as our primary research sources.

By transforming complex scientific information into simple and interactive stories, the project makes space exploration more accessible and engaging for young learners. It encourages curiosity, builds awareness of historical space missions, and helps preserve the legacy of remarkable space equipment. Our long-term goal is to make these stories accessible worldwide and inspire the next generation of space explorers.

Rovelore Chronicles is unique because of It's storytelling-based approach, combining interactive planetary exploration, voice-acted character conversations, and authentic multimedia resources. Throughout development, our team prioritized educational accuracy, child-friendly content, accessibility, intuitive navigation, user experience, and technical feasibility to create an engaging educational platform.
